messages:
Claudia: Hey team — two tiny life updates: I moved into a studio in SoMa last week and also accepted a promotion to Senior PM today! :tada: Could we do a micro celebration in the office next week? Nothing fancy, just cake + plants.
Ravi: omg congrats!! :confetti_ball: When are you thinking?
Claudia: Thanks!! Hoping for Wed afternoon (3pm) or Thurs lunch. Which works better?
Nia: Wed 3pm works for me. Happy to bring cake (vegan option too).
Jordan: Thurs lunch is slightly better for my schedule. I can grab savory stuff from the deli nearby.
Mira: I can bring a plant/random succulent as a housewarming gift. Congrats!! :seedling:
Sam: Huge congrats, Claudia. Senior PM!! so proud :raised_hands: I vote Wed so we can do a proper toast before sprint planning.
Kala: Wed works. I'll reserve Conf B for 3–3:45 and post an invite. Can someone add a quick poll for cake vs cupcakes vs empanadas? :smile:
Claudia: Vote: :cake: Wed cake, :cupcake: cupcakes, :taco: empanadas — I don't want to be the boss who picks empanadas for their own promo 😂
Ravi: :cake:
Nia: :cupcake:
Jordan: :taco:
Mira: :cake: (but I will love anything)
Kala: Party-bot: RSVP reminder — please react by EOD Tuesday.
party-bot: Reminder set: "Claudia celebration" on 1718978400 (Wed 3pm) — 5 responses so far.
Claudia: Love you all. I'll DM logistics to Kala. If anyone wants to swing by my new place for a tiny housewarming later in the month, I can host a Sunday brunch. No pressure. :heart:
